verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot can be assigned as a reviewer on PRs ('Assign initial reviews to Copilot for greater speed and quality') and Copilot Autofix analyzes code changes to apply security fixes automatically, directly matching the AI-reviewer-suggests-fixes story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of Copilot's PR review quality/accuracy and more detail on general (non-security) code review suggestions beyond vulnerability fixes.
